limitations: The 10M database path uses a representative ledger/read-model schema, not the formal 2.0 schema, allocation engine or Statement implementation.
The Gateway path is the real v1.0.0-final pipeline against a local deterministic stub; it does not contain 2.0 RLS, organization, budget or period code.

The 10M database profile reuses the prior structured result because that PoC imports no product code and its input fingerprints are unchanged; its original raw stdout was not preserved and the database profile was not rerun in this Final archive pass.
Streams were held for 120 ms with tiny request bodies; realistic payload distribution, multi-minute streams, steady RPS and upstream failure rates remain Gate 2 work.
The load generator ran on the same host and no per-container CPU/RSS time series was captured.
A single restore proves recoverability and observed RTO only; it does not prove a continuously operated RPO schedule, encryption or retention policy.
Redis, Worker, object storage, full Compose, PostgreSQL failover and production network/storage were not fault-injected.
500/200 achieved 100% functional success but failed the <=150 ms incremental TTFT target, so it is a Gate 2 stretch target rather than the standard default or an open P1 on this PoC object.

gate_assessment.current_poc_outcome: The Stage 01 calibration question is closed with a frozen 50/20 default envelope.
gate_assessment.gate2_stretch_target: 500 Gateway and 200 streaming concurrency; qualification is deferred to W20-19 on the complete 2.0 candidate and is not a current P1.
followup_implementation_gates: Requalify the 50/20 default envelope on the complete 2.0 candidate and target BOM.
Run the 500/200 stretch profile with realistic long streams, payload distribution and steady request rate.
Complete full Compose fault injection, encrypted backup scheduling, retention and isolated recovery evidence in W20-18/W20-19.
residual_risks: Cloud cost, external PostgreSQL/Redis, other CPU architectures and object-storage throughput remain target-environment calibration risks.
